newsitem.title: GERMANY: German officials seize heroin at Polish border.
newsitem.headline: German officials seize heroin at Polish border.

text.p: German officials said on Thursday they had seized 26 kg of heroin with a street value of around 4.5 million marks ($2.6 million) at the Polish border.
The state prosecutor in the city of Cottbus, Wilfired Robineck, said one Polish man was detained after customs officers found the drug in his car on Wednesday.
Robineck said the heroin had a a high purity level of between 40 and 50 percent and was the second largest seizure customs officers had ever made at the border.
